citations.quote: STRIVERDI RESPIMAT is a long-acting \beta_2-agonist indicated for long-term, once-daily maintenance bronchodilator treatment of airflow obstruction in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), including chronic bronchitis and/or emphysema.

target_moa.text: Olodaterol is a long-acting beta2-adrenergic agonist (LABA) that binds and activates beta2-adrenoceptors in the airways, stimulating intracellular adenylyl cyclase to increase cyclic AMP (cAMP), which induces bronchodilation by relaxing airway smooth muscle; it has 241-fold greater agonist activity at beta2- vs beta1-adrenoceptors

citations.quote: Olodaterol is a long-acting \beta_2-adrenergic agonist (LABA). The compound exerts its pharmacological effects by binding and activation of \beta_2-adrenoceptors after topical administration by inhalation.

Activation of these receptors in the airways results in a stimulation of intracellular adenylyl cyclase, an enzyme that mediates the synthesis of cyclic-3', 5' adenosine monophosphate (cAMP). Elevated levels of cAMP induce bronchodilation by relaxation of airway smooth muscle cells.
olodaterol has 241-fold greater agonist activity at \beta_2-adrenoceptors compared to \beta_1-adrenoceptors
Olodaterol is a long-acting \beta_2-adrenergic agonist (LABA).

detail.text: Asthma-Related Death: Long-acting beta2-adrenergic agonists (LABA) increase the risk of asthma-related death. A placebo-controlled US study with another LABA (salmeterol) showed an increase in asthma-related deaths; this is considered a class effect. STRIVERDI RESPIMAT is not indicated for the treatment of asthma

citations.quote: Long-acting \beta_2-adrenergic agonists (LABA) increase the risk of asthma-related death. Data from a large, placebo-controlled US study that compared the safety of another long-acting \beta_2-adrenergic agonist (salmeterol) or placebo added to usual asthma therapy showed an increase in asthma-related deaths in patients receiving salmeterol.

Long-acting beta2-adrenergic agonists, such as STRIVERDI RESPIMAT, increase the risk of asthma-related death. STRIVERDI RESPIMAT is not indicated for the treatment of asthma [see *Boxed Warning and Warning and Precautions* (5.1)].

vote.text: Pulmonary-Allergy Drugs Advisory Committee (PADAC) held January 29, 2013 voted favorably on approvability (15 yes, 1 no, 1 abstain); also voted favorably on efficacy (15 yes, 1 no, 1 abstain) and safety (15 yes, 1 no, 1 abstain)

citations.quote: A meeting of the Pulmonary-Allergy Drugs Advisory Committee (PADAC) was held on January 29, 2013, to discuss this application.

the Committee voted favorably regarding whether there was substantial evidence of efficacy (15 yes, 1 no, and 1 abstain), and also voted favorably on the safety of olodaterol (15 yes, 1 no, and 1 abstain). Regarding the approvability question, which is essentially the sum of the demonstration of efficacy and safety, the results were in favor of approval (15 yes, 1 no, and 1 abstain).

summary.text: Standard 505(b) NDA for olodaterol received May 14, 2012. The application was discussed at a PADAC meeting on January 29, 2013 that voted 15 to 1 favoring approval. A Complete Response was issued 3/14/13 solely due to GMP/manufacturing facility deficiencies; after the sponsor resolved manufacturing issues and resubmitted, the NDA was approved based on adequate clinical data demonstrating efficacy and LABA-class safety in COPD

This application was also discussed a Pulmonary Allergy Drugs Advisory Committee (PADAC) meeting held on 1/29/13. The PADAC vote 15 to 1 favoring approval.
